numerical_claims.claim: Heimstaden Bostad completed approximately EUR 59.5 billion of financing.
numerical_claims.label: INCORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Bank Financing in Heimstaden Bostad (page 19) states: 'For the year 2025, approximately SEK 44,900 million was raised... For subsidiary Heimstaden Bostad, financing markets remained strong, with SEK 44,900 million of asset-backed financing... and SEK 14,600 million of capital markets issuance... Total for Heimstaden Bostad: SEK 59,500 million (41,900) including both refinancings and new financings.' SEK 59,500 million equals approximately EUR 5.95 billion, not EUR 59.5 billion.
numerical_claims.error_explanation: Candidate misstates the financing amount as EUR 59.5 billion; the source reports SEK 59,500 million, which converts to approximately EUR 5.95 billion.
